summary: AMASS Corner-inspired brand refresh verification — FRONTEND ONLY on web preview (390x844) at https://property-os-africa.preview.emergentagent.com. SPLASH '/': testID splash-screen renders amass-brand-moment first (splash-amass-lockup visible, tagline "AFRICA'S PROPERTY OPERATING SYSTEM" rendered via uppercase label with 1.8 letter-spacing), auto-transitions to fixa-brand-moment at ~2.4s with the fixa-pro-lockup card and the tagline "A great platform for service providers and those who need services.", then auto-routes to /onboarding when signed-out. brand-skip pill is present and tappable (tested). ONBOARDING /onboarding (signed-out): all 5 slides render in order. Slide 0 kind=amass: onboarding-title-0 = "africa's property operating system", onboarding-amass-lockup present with bounding box width/height = 198/161 → ratio 1.230 (matches the required ~1.23 LOCKUP_ASPECT exactly, image is not stretched); tile labels Lekki Phase 1 / Ikoyi / Maitama all present in DOM with opacity:1 (Lekki Phase 1 visually truncates to "Lekki Pha" inside the 90px tile — expected numberOfLines:1 behaviour); onboarding-next labelled "Continue". Slide 1 kind=fixa: onboarding-title-1 contains "meet FIXA", onboarding-fixa-lockup present, all 5 chips (repairs/electrical/plumbing/painting/movers) visible. Slide 2: title "verified listings. zero surprises.". Slide 3: title "two tokens. one simple wallet." with all three bullets (MASS unlocks… / FIX pays… / Earn both…) visible. Slide 4: title "services, brands and AI insights", onboarding-next labelled "Get started" → routes to /login. onboarding-skip and onboarding-signin both route to /login. Dots row shows 5 dots with the active one wider (24dp vs 8dp via Dot spring). AUTH BRANDING: amass-logo-lockup rendered above the heading on /login, /register, /forgot-password, /phone, and /about. LOGIN: demo@amass.africa / amass2026 succeeds and lands on / (home map) directly. REGRESSION SMOKE: /, /discover, /neighbours, /profile, /wallet, /notifications all render without red screen and without pageerrors; home map (/) shows amass-logo-emblem at top-left; wallet shows MASS/FIX chips in the top bar (12,692 / 590). No console.error pageerrors fired during any navigation; the only console noise was the pre-existing RN-web deprecations ("shadow*" / "props.pointerEvents") and expo-notifications web warning, both unchanged from iteration_57.

issues: Tile label 'Lekki Phase 1' visually truncates to 'Lekki Pha…' because tileW ≈ width*0.23 ≈ 90dp and the label pill is numberOfLines:1 with 8px side padding. The DOM text is intact ('Lekki Phase 1'); this is a numberOfLines=1 clip, not a bug. If the full label is desired on the collage, either shorten the string to 'Lekki' or widen the pill (bottom:6, left/right 6 could be left/right 2) or allow numberOfLines=2 with a smaller font. Minor, not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow; 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated → use style.pointerEvents. Logged on every bundle. Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_57.

'[Reanimated] Property [transform] may be overwritten by a layout animation. Please wrap your component with an animated view and apply the layout animation on the wrapper.' logged 5× on onboarding mount. Caused by combining FadeInDown entering animation with explicit transform:[{rotate:…}] on the tile/chip Animated.Views in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx (AmassHero tiles L283, FixaHero chip L338, FeatureHero chip L378). Fix: wrap the rotated card in an outer <Animated.View entering={…}> and keep the transform/rotate on an inner plain <View>. Visual output is correct — this is a dev-only warning.

action_items: (Optional) Resolve Reanimated layout-animation warning on onboarding by splitting the entering animation and the rotate transform onto separate Animated.View / View wrappers (AmassHero tile L283, FixaHero chip L338, FeatureHero chip L378).
(Optional cosmetic) The 'Lekki Phase 1' label clips to 'Lekki Pha…' inside the 90dp collage tile. Shorten to 'Lekki' or widen/allow 2 lines if the full name is required visually.
(Carried from iteration_57) Sweep 'shadow*' → boxShadow and 'props.pointerEvents' → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecations.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/index.tsx: Splash phase timers (HOLD_MS=2000, FADE_MS=420) correctly schedule AMASS→FIXA transition at 2420ms and ready at 4840ms. Reduced-motion safe (Rise/Bob/Sweep all early-return when reduce=true). Sweep further bails on web (Platform.OS === 'web') so no gloss artifact on web preview. navigated.current guard prevents double-router.replace.

frontend/app/onboarding.tsx: Correct Expo-Router finish target `/(auth)/login`; FlatList uses getItemLayout for stable paging; scrollHandler guards `i !== current.value` before `runOnJS(onIndex)` to avoid redundant setState. Dots animate width via withSpring (active 24dp vs 8dp).

frontend/src/components/AmassLogo.tsx: LOCKUP_ASPECT=1.2303 and LOCKUP_OVER_EMBLEM=877/637 are the measured intrinsic ratios of the shipped artwork; measured on-screen bounding box at onboarding slide 0 = 198×161 → 1.230 (exact match). No stretch, no crop. testID defaults to 'amass-logo-lockup' / 'amass-logo-emblem' as expected by the review spec.

frontend/app/onboarding.tsx: On the frosted glass panel the BlurView is correctly skipped on web (Platform.OS !== 'web' check at L301) and replaced with a solid rgba(255,255,255,0.88) panel — matches the agent-to-agent note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all testIDs in the review spec present, splash dual-brand transition + auto-route verified, onboarding titles / lockups / chips / bullets / CTA labels verified, all auth routes carry amass-logo-lockup, login + tabs smoke renders without red-screen or pageerror

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login still works with demo@amass.africa / amass2026 and now routes straight to '/' (home map) — phone verification detour was NOT required during this run. All brand testIDs: splash-screen, amass-brand-moment, splash-amass-lockup, fixa-brand-moment, brand-skip, onboarding-screen, onboarding-title-{0..4}, onboarding-amass-lockup, onboarding-fixa-lockup, onboarding-next, onboarding-skip, onboarding-signin, amass-logo-lockup (auth + /about), amass-logo-emblem (map header).
